confirmed.title: Books can be closed through TODAY while the business is still trading. Online orders completed after that are filed with the fiscal POS but never reach the ledger: no exception and no backfill (loyalty liability too)
confirmed.repro:
1) CEO (x-servd-active-tenant: A) with a drawer still open: POST /api/v1/accounting/period-close {lockedThrough:'2026-10-11' (today PKT), note:'Day closed at 8pm'} -> 201.
2) Customer: POST /storefront/orders {conceptSlug:'flipd', type:'pickup', paymentGateway:'cash', items:[Loaded Fries x2]} -> 201 (order 5ea01f84…, total 149,500, tax 19,500). gmA: PATCH /orders/:id/status confirmed -> preparing -> ready -> completed, all 200.
3) gmA: POST /procurement/bills dated today -> 422 PERIOD_LOCKED. cashierA1: POST /pos/shifts/:open/close -> 200.
4) CEO: POST /accounting/period-close/reopen {reason} -> 200, then POST /reconciliation/backfill-unposted {dryRun:false} -> 200.
5) Check journal_entries for 'order.complete:5ea01f84…', exception_flags for the order, fiscal_documents for the order, loyalty_accounts.pointsBalance vs ledger 2060.
confirmed.expected: Closing a day refuses the current trading day (or any day with an open drawer or open orders), since BOOKS-07's fix says 'close a date that has already happened'. Failing that, every posting the ledger refuses raises an exception and can be re-posted after a reopen, for online orders, refunds and loyalty as well as till closes.
confirmed.actual: The lock through today is accepted. The online order completes and its sale is filed with the fiscal POS (TEST-SRB-B21D114B95), but order.complete never posts. API log: '[journal] postOrderCompletion failed for 5ea01f84…: Cannot post to 2026-10-11 — books are closed through 2026-10-11' and '[loyalty] postLoyaltyEarn failed …'. No exception flag is raised for the order (0 rows). After reopen, backfill-unposted only re-posts SHIFTS: the till close posted, but 'JE sf' is still false. The ledger is now permanently short: /reports/sales says tax 266,046 while ledger output tax is 246,546 (diff 19,500 = this order's GST), and report net exceeds the ledger by 130,000 (= its ex-GST value). The SRB return therefore understates against what the fiscal POS filed. Loyalty points outstanding are 4,370 (= PKR 437.00) against 2060 = PKR 287.50. Today's supplier deliveries are refused all evening (422). The till close is flagged and recoverable, so only the online/loyalty side is silent.
confirmed.evidence: Script backend/.sim/books-r2/locktoday.ts; output scratchpad/audit/books-r2/locktoday.out and cross.out. API log scratchpad/audit/books-r2-api.log lines with 'postOrderCompletion failed for 5ea01f84' and 'postLoyaltyEarn failed for a3d0cc48'. DB: SELECT sum(pointsBalance) FROM loyalty_accounts = 4370; 2060 balance = 28750.
confirmed.suspectedCause: backend/src/modules/accounting/routes.ts:779-788: the lock bound is today.to (pktToday), so the current day can be locked. backend/src/modules/orders/service.ts:1802-1804: postOrderCompletion failures are only console.error'd (unlike the till close, which calls flagShiftPostingFailed in pos/service.ts:1194-1205). The loyalty earn posting likewise only logs. backend/src/modules/reconciliation/routes.ts:260-267: backfill-unposted covers closed shifts only.
confirmed.suggestedFix: Refuse a lock through today PKT (the latest allowed is yesterday), or refuse while any drawer of that day is open. Wrap postOrderCompletion, postOrderRefund and the loyalty postings the way the till close is wrapped, raising a high posting_failed exception with the order id. Extend backfill-unposted (or add a sibling) to re-post order.complete, order.refund and loyalty entries that are missing for completed or refunded orders.

verdict.reason:
The finding holds up. None of the intended behaviour changes covers it, and I could not trace it to a setup mistake. I ran it as the CEO (admin) in company A, with the active-company header set and no fiscal connector configured. Five things combine:

1. **Today can be closed.** POST /accounting/period-close accepts the current PKT day. The bound in backend/src/modules/accounting/routes.ts:779-788 is `today.to`, and tests/auditAccounting.test.ts asserts that today is accepted. The admin page (frontend/admin/src/app/accounting/period-close/page.tsx:33) also defaults the date field to today, so a CEO closing books in the evening while still trading is a realistic scenario.
2. **Online sales then miss the ledger silently.** Every online order completed after that lock has its `order.complete` posting refused by postJournalEntry with PERIOD_LOCKED. completeOrder only logs this with console.error (orders/service.ts:1802-1804). No exception flag is raised.
3. **The loyalty earn is lost the same way.** bookEarn in loyalty/service.ts:212-222 catches and logs the PERIOD_LOCKED refusal and does nothing else.
4. **Nothing posts these entries later.**
   - `/reconciliation/backfill-unposted` only handles shifts (backfillUnpostedShifts, which reads `shift.close`).
   - recoverIncompleteCompletions only re-creates missing fiscal sale documents. It never re-posts the ledger.
   - A repeated status write does nothing.
   - I found no route that re-posts `order.complete` or `loyalty.earn`.
5. **The two records disagree for good.** The fiscal sale document exists ('held' in my run; filed with a TEST number in the auditor's run once live), but the ledger has no revenue or output tax for that sale. The sales-tax return reads `order.complete` and `shift.close` entries, so it understates against the fiscal POS. Account 2060 understates the points actually outstanding.

The till close is the one path that is flagged and recoverable; online and loyalty postings are not, as the finding says.

**Severity:** I rate it high. The loss is silent and permanent, covers revenue, GST and loyalty liability, and the UI defaults to the risky date. The trigger is admin-only, but it is a one-click default action.

**Scope note:** any other refusal of postOrderCompletion (not only a lock) is equally silent for online orders. The suggested fixes are sensible: refuse a lock through today (or while drawers are open), flag refused order and loyalty postings like the till close, and extend the backfill to `order.complete`, `order.refund` and loyalty entries.
verdict.evidence:
**Test setup:** /home/user/servd/backend/.sim/books-r2/verify/locktoday.test.ts with config .sim/books-r2/verify/vitest.config.ts. It ran against DB servd_test_rv_books_0 and Redis db 26. Output is in scratchpad/audit/books-r2/verify0.out. All 3 tests passed, confirming the behaviour described in the finding.

**Control test (no lock):** the online order posts `order.complete`, and its loyalty earn (1495 pts) posts `loyalty.earn`.

**Lock-through-today test:**
- POST /accounting/period-close {lockedThrough:'2026-10-11'} returned 201 (lockedThrough 2026-10-11T18:59:59.999Z).
- An online order (source servd, total 149,500, tax 19,500) was completed via updateOrderStatus and its status is 'completed'.
- The fiscal_documents sale row exists with status 'held'.
- No journal entry `order.complete:<id>` exists.
- The loyalty earn transaction exists (1495 pts), but no `loyalty.earn:<tx>` entry exists.
- Only console output:
  - `[journal] postOrderCompletion failed for de5d3e54…: Cannot post to 2026-10-11 — books are closed through 2026-10-11`
  - `[loyalty] postLoyaltyEarn failed for 964d9245…: Cannot post to 2026-10-11 …`
- exception_flags for the company: [] (none at all).

**Recovery attempts:** I reopened the period (200), then:
- POST /reconciliation/backfill-unposted {dryRun:false} returned {rows:[],summary:{}}.
- recoverIncompleteCompletions({graceMs:0}) returned {completed:0,saleEnqueued:0,flagged:0}.
- A repeated completion did nothing.
- Both entries are still missing afterwards.

**Resulting ledger gap:**
- Points outstanding are 2990 (PKR 299) against a 2060 balance of PKR 149.50.
- Ledger output tax is 19,500 against completed orders' taxCents of 39,000.

**Lock-through-yesterday control:** the same order flow posts `order.complete` normally.

**Code references:**
- accounting/routes.ts:779-788 (bound is pktToday().to)
- orders/service.ts:1802-1804 (catch and console.error only)
- loyalty/service.ts:212-222 (bookEarn swallows the error)
- reconciliation/routes.ts:260-273 and accounting/shiftPosting.ts:563ff (shifts only)
- orders/service.ts:1931-1984 (recovery re-creates fiscal documents only)
- frontend/admin/src/app/accounting/period-close/page.tsx:33,109 (defaults to today, max=today)

lows.title: Turning 'Fiscal reporting required' OFF leaves the company's earlier held sales held forever, and /health keeps warning about them
lows.repro: Company B is never configured (driver none). Ring and pay two B sales while reporting is ON -> fiscal_documents sale/held/no_connector. CEO: PUT /connectors/fiscal/reporting-required {required:false, reason:'GSX Viva commissary is non-commercial for this test'} with x-servd-active-tenant: B -> 200. Ring another B sale. GET /connectors (adminB) and GET /health.
lows.expected: docs/TAX_SETUP.md §2: 'Off … no fiscal documents, no held backlog, no alerts'. Either the switch says what happens to the existing held documents (and offers the CEO a path), or they stop being counted as a backlog.
lows.actual: New B sales get no document and the receipt prints 'Not a tax invoice' (correct). The 3 earlier documents stay 'held' (counts.held = 3), and /health reports 'fiscalConnector: warn … 3 sales held in total until go-live / registration' with no end. Releasing them is 409 NOT_LIVE, and a non-commercial company will never go live. The only exit is 'record manual filing' one document at a time.
lows.evidence: Output scratchpad/audit/books-r2/bfiscal.out: B docs [[sale,held,no_connector,207000],[sale,held,no_connector,517500],[sale,held,no_connector,583200]]; B counts {held:3}. /health detail as quoted.
lows.suspectedCause: backend/src/connectors/health.ts and fiscalCounts count held documents without checking fiscalReportingRequired(tenantId). The reporting-required PUT (modules/connectors/routes.ts:406-427) does not touch existing held rows. config.ts:118 fiscalReportingRequired is only read at sale time.
lows.suggestedFix: When a company's reporting is OFF, exclude its held documents from /health and alerts. Show them on the connector page as 'held before reporting was switched off', and have the CEO's switch-off confirmation state how many there are. Leave them unskipped, so a later switch back ON can still release them, in line with the no-skip rule.
